description: Search the tracked 13F filer set by institution name or SEC CIK. Search first requires every punctuation-independent query word anywhere in the filed name, then broadens to any word only when no strict row matches. Verified brand aliases such as Fidelity, Vanguard, and BlackRock include their current flagship CIK. Results are largest within the recently-active filing bucket first and include latest report date, tracked 13F position value, and position count so same-name filers can be compared before calling an institution tool. Values use report-date closing prices, may fall back to filer values, and can be zero when unvalued. Scoped institution tools remain strict and never discard an unmatched word. Each result shows its entity type from regulatory records, and holderTypes filters by it.

holderTypes.description: Holder types to keep, as an array of tokens: adv (registered investment adviser), era (exempt reporting adviser), ia (other adviser), bank, ins (insurer), bd (broker-dealer), fund (registered fund), plan (benefit plan), nonus (non-US institution), hc (parent holding company or control person with no other type on record), unk (no deciding record yet), e.g. ["bank", "ins"]. Types come from Form ADV, SEC filer profiles, 13D/13G and N-CEN, never from names. Omit for all.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, clamped to 1-500)

query.description: Search query — institution name, partial name, or CIK
